name: SoCalGas Adelanto Lateral
researcher_notes: The Energy Information Administration August 2026 pipeline projects workbook, Historical Projects sheet, Excel row 227, lists SoCal Adelanto Lateral for Southern California Gas Co: an expansion, completed February 2002, in California, 32 miles, 30 inch, 200 MMcf/d, intrastate, state regulated. The tracker has no row for it. P6233 is the whole SoCalGas system at 3640 miles, so this is a segment with no row of its own and adds more than 25 km of pipe. The source says 40 in a column next to length that is not labeled here, so only the 32 miles, 30 inch and 200 MMcf/d values are used. This is one source only and no second source was found. A web search for a second source could not be run because of a session limit. Start and end points are not stated in the workbook, so they are left blank. Owner is Southern California Gas Co, but the ownership team's name list has no exact match, so no owner was staged; a person should set it. Intrastate lines do not appear in the Federal Energy Regulatory Commission records, so their absence is not a concern. Route not searched; marked as no route. Confidence is medium.
